title: Habit Streak Break Day-of-Week Bias
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar exports (`calendar:event`), email metadata (`email:metadata`), password-audit reports (`passwordmanager:audit`).
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, password-audit exports, and calendar/email feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:entry completed=false
| eval dow=strftime(_time,"%A")
| stats count as misses by habit dow
| sort - misses
description: Counts habit misses by day of week so you can spot whether Sundays, travel days, or midweek chaos are the true streak killers.
value: Streak breaks feel random until you bin them; once the weak day is visible, you can design around it.
implementation: Forward habit completion events with boolean completion status; review miss-heavy weekdays and pre-plan support for them.
visualization: Heatmap of habit misses by weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It checks which day of the week is most likely to break your good habits.
